citation: Doumas, Christos G. 1983. Thera: Pompeii of the Ancient Aegean — Excavations at Akrotiri, 1967–79. New Aspects of Antiquity. London: Thames and Hudson. 168 pp., figs., plates. ISBN 0-500-39016-9.
notes: Secondary popular-scholarly synthesis of the Akrotiri excavations under Marinatos and Doumas. Site-level primary final report series is separate; use this volume for overview of LBA Theran settlement, frescoes, and destruction by the volcanic eruption — absolute date of eruption remains debated (see Manning et al. 2006). Subtitle Pompeii is framing, not a cultural identity claim. No invented page numbers.
